findings.finding: One authoritative execution/state source should feed both work and visible projection. The source explicitly records prior failure from display/session separation and prohibits a second truth store in the regelkreis contract.

The historical Global Workspace existed structurally but only 4 of 16 listed consumers read workspace_broadcast. Component presence therefore overstates integration; actual re-entry/fan-out/effect must be tested.

Exact numeric state, qualitative model-facing projection, and slow learned weights/dispositions are explicitly separated as Zahl -> Wort -> Gewicht. Preserve provenance and promotion boundaries between these layers.
Judged terminal evidence is immutable; rework is a new run. Worker completion requires measured after-value/proof and independent remeasurement rather than report acceptance.
Event-driven visual/runtime behavior should reach explicit quiescence. Knet contract requires zero requestAnimationFrame passes at idle and robustness after 100 random interactions.
Apps must not poll; state flows from an event stream. Missing sources and errors remain explicit instead of becoming invented or silently empty projections.
